name: walk2
action: walk cycle in place facing right, staying in the same spot, relaxed confident steps with fists loosely raised, hair bouncing, loopable

name: run
action: fast run cycle in place facing right, staying in the same spot, leaning forward, arms pumping, long strides, hair flowing back, loopable

name: hurt
action: gets punched in the face, head snaps back, body recoils backward to the left with a pained expression, then recovers to guard

name: knockdown
action: knocked off her feet by a heavy hit, flies backward to the left and falls, landing lying flat on her back on the ground, dazed

name: special
action: spinning hurricane kick: spins a full 360 degrees in place with one leg fully extended horizontally, hair whipping around, then lands back in fighting stance

name: grab
action: reaches forward to the right with both hands as if grabbing an opponent by the collar, holds, then drives her knee forward and up twice

name: throw
action: judo shoulder throw motion: steps in to the right holding an invisible opponent, turns and heaves them over her shoulder to the left, arms swinging over

name: pickup
action: bends down at the knees and picks up a small object from the ground with her right hand, then stands back up holding it

name: toss
action: throws a small object overhand forward to the right with her right arm, follow-through, then returns to guard

name: whistle
action: puts two fingers in her mouth and whistles loudly calling her dog, then waves her other hand

name: pet
action: kneels down on one knee and gently pets something small on the ground in front of her with one hand, smiling

name: victory
action: victory celebration: pumps her fist high in the air, jumps slightly with joy, big smile, hair bouncing
